You are an SRE copilot performing root cause analysis for a production incident. Using the telemetry findings and runbook guidance below, produce a concise RCA and propose exactly one remediation action.

Service: image-processing-service

Telemetry findings:
--- Logs ---
WARN cache miss rate elevated: 91% misses on thumbnail cache
ERROR CDN origin overload: origin_requests_per_sec=4200 (expected <500)
--- Metrics ---
{"cache_hit_rate_pct": 9.0, "origin_load_pct": 98.0, "latency_p99_ms": 7400}

Runbook guidance:
image-processing-service cache poisoning/invalidation pattern: a bad deploy or TTL misconfiguration can drop the cache hit rate, overloading the origin. Mitigate by clearing and rewarming the cache.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "rca_summary" (1-2 sentences), "remediation_action" (a short snake_case slug, e.g. "rolling_restart"), "remediation_target" (the k8s resource name), "remediation_reason" (one sentence).

{"rca_summary": "image-processing-service's thumbnail cache hit rate has collapsed to 9%, pushing nearly all traffic to the origin (98% load) and driving up latency.", "remediation_action": "clear_cache", "remediation_target": "image-processing-thumbnail-cache", "remediation_reason": "Clearing and rewarming the cache resolves the stale/poisoned entries causing the abnormal miss rate."}

You are an SRE copilot performing root cause analysis for a production incident. Using the telemetry findings and runbook guidance below, produce a concise RCA and propose exactly one remediation action.

Service: checkout-service

Telemetry findings:
--- Logs ---
ERROR OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
WARN GC pause duration=4200ms (old_gen_usage=96%)
--- Metrics ---
{"memory_utilization_pct": 97.1, "restart_count_1h": 4, "latency_p99_ms": 8900}

Runbook guidance:
checkout-service memory leak pattern: gradual heap growth over hours ending in OOM kills. Immediate mitigation is a rolling restart to reclaim memory; root cause requires heap dump analysis.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "rca_summary" (1-2 sentences), "remediation_action" (a short snake_case slug, e.g. "rolling_restart"), "remediation_target" (the k8s resource name), "remediation_reason" (one sentence).

{"rca_summary": "checkout-service is OOMing due to old-gen heap exhaustion, consistent with a slow memory leak; 4 restarts in the last hour indicate the pod is crash-looping under memory pressure.", "remediation_action": "rolling_restart", "remediation_target": "checkout-service-deployment", "remediation_reason": "A rolling restart reclaims leaked heap memory immediately and stops the crash loop while the leak is investigated."}

You are an SRE copilot performing root cause analysis for a production incident. Using the telemetry findings and runbook guidance below, produce a concise RCA and propose exactly one remediation action.

Service: notifications-service

Telemetry findings:
--- Logs ---
ERROR SQSConsumerStalled: no messages consumed in last 10m despite queue depth=48213
WARN consumer lag increasing: lag=48213 messages
--- Metrics ---
{"queue_depth": 48213, "consumer_lag_sec": 612, "cpu_utilization_pct": 12.4}

Runbook guidance:
notifications-service queue backlog: low CPU with a growing queue usually indicates a stuck/deadlocked consumer rather than a capacity issue. Mitigate with a rolling restart of the consumer pods.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "rca_summary" (1-2 sentences), "remediation_action" (a short snake_case slug, e.g. "rolling_restart"), "remediation_target" (the k8s resource name), "remediation_reason" (one sentence).

{"rca_summary": "notifications-service consumers have stalled (CPU at only 12.4% while queue depth grows to 48k), indicating a deadlocked or hung consumer process rather than insufficient capacity.", "remediation_action": "rolling_restart", "remediation_target": "notifications-service-deployment", "remediation_reason": "Low CPU with a growing queue points to a stuck consumer, which a rolling restart will clear without needing more capacity."}

You are an SRE copilot performing root cause analysis for a production incident. Using the telemetry findings and runbook guidance below, produce a concise RCA and propose exactly one remediation action.

Service: payment-service

Telemetry findings:
--- Logs ---
ERROR PostgresConnectionPoolTimeout: timeout after 30000ms waiting for connection from pool (size=50, overflow=10, checked_out=60)
WARN slow query detected duration=28410ms (idle_in_transaction=true)
--- Metrics ---
{"http_5xx_rate_pct": 18.7, "latency_p99_ms": 6240, "connection_pool_utilization_pct": 99.4}

Runbook guidance:
payment-service connection pool exhaustion: caused by leaked connections or idle-in-transaction queries. Mitigate with a rolling restart of the deployment to release stuck connections; follow up by fixing the leaking code path.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "rca_summary" (1-2 sentences), "remediation_action" (a short snake_case slug, e.g. "rolling_restart"), "remediation_target" (the k8s resource name), "remediation_reason" (one sentence).

{"rca_summary": "Postgres connection pool exhaustion on payment-service, driven by idle-in-transaction queries holding connections open; pool utilization at 99.4% is causing 504s and elevated p99 latency.", "remediation_action": "rolling_restart", "remediation_target": "payment-service-deployment", "remediation_reason": "A rolling restart releases the stuck/leaked connections and restores pool headroom immediately."}

You are an SRE copilot performing root cause analysis for a production incident. Using the telemetry findings and runbook guidance below, produce a concise RCA and propose exactly one remediation action.

Service: search-service

Telemetry findings:
--- Logs ---
ERROR DiskFullError: no space left on device (/var/lib/elasticsearch, 2% free)
WARN index write rejected: disk watermark exceeded
--- Metrics ---
{"disk_utilization_pct": 98.4, "indexing_latency_ms": 15200, "http_5xx_rate_pct": 22.1}

Runbook guidance:
search-service disk pressure: index segments and old snapshots fill the volume over time. Mitigate by expanding the persistent volume claim; restarts will not help since disk is full.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "rca_summary" (1-2 sentences), "remediation_action" (a short snake_case slug, e.g. "rolling_restart"), "remediation_target" (the k8s resource name), "remediation_reason" (one sentence).

{"rca_summary": "search-service's data volume is at 98.4% utilization, causing write rejections and indexing failures due to the disk watermark being exceeded.", "remediation_action": "scale_storage", "remediation_target": "search-service-pvc", "remediation_reason": "Expanding the persistent volume claim directly addresses the disk-full condition; a restart would not free space."}

You are an SRE copilot performing root cause analysis for a production incident. Using the telemetry findings and runbook guidance below, produce a concise RCA and propose exactly one remediation action.

Service: auth-service

Telemetry findings:
--- Logs ---
ERROR TokenValidationTimeout: redis client timed out validating token after 2000ms
WARN cache eviction observed: evicted_keys=184 policy=allkeys-lru used_memory=0.98*maxmemory
--- Metrics ---
{"http_5xx_rate_pct": 6.3, "cache_hit_rate_pct": 54.2, "redis_used_memory_pct": 97.8}

Runbook guidance:
auth-service token cache pressure: redis nearing maxmemory triggers evictions mid-validation. Mitigate by scaling redis replicas or increasing memory; short-term, scale auth-service replicas to spread cache load.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "rca_summary" (1-2 sentences), "remediation_action" (a short snake_case slug, e.g. "rolling_restart"), "remediation_target" (the k8s resource name), "remediation_reason" (one sentence).

{"rca_summary": "Redis session-token cache is at 97.8% memory, evicting keys mid-validation and causing TokenValidationTimeout errors; cache hit rate has dropped to 54.2%.", "remediation_action": "scale_replicas", "remediation_target": "auth-service-deployment", "remediation_reason": "Scaling auth-service replicas spreads cache load and reduces contention while the redis memory limit is addressed."}

You are an SRE copilot performing root cause analysis for a production incident. Using the telemetry findings and runbook guidance below, produce a concise RCA and propose exactly one remediation action.

Service: recommendation-service

Telemetry findings:
--- Logs ---
WARN request queue depth exceeds capacity: pending=890, max_concurrency=100
ERROR 503 Service Unavailable: thread pool exhausted
--- Metrics ---
{"http_5xx_rate_pct": 31.5, "requests_per_sec": 2400, "cpu_utilization_pct": 94.8, "replica_count": 3}

Runbook guidance:
recommendation-service traffic spike pattern: sustained high CPU and request queueing under normal error budgets usually means under-provisioned replicas for current load. Mitigate by scaling out replicas.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: "rca_summary" (1-2 sentences), "remediation_action" (a short snake_case slug, e.g. "rolling_restart"), "remediation_target" (the k8s resource name), "remediation_reason" (one sentence).

{"rca_summary": "recommendation-service is under-provisioned for current traffic: CPU at 94.8% across only 3 replicas with 2400 rps is exhausting the thread pool and causing 503s.", "remediation_action": "scale_replicas", "remediation_target": "recommendation-service-deployment", "remediation_reason": "Scaling out replicas adds capacity to absorb the current traffic level and relieve CPU and thread-pool saturation."}
